name: What are the common causes of roof ridge damage in the DFW area?

mainEntity.name: What are the common causes of roof ridge damage in the DFW area?

acceptedAnswer.text: In the DFW area, common causes of roof ridge damage include severe weather events such as hailstorms, strong winds, and heavy rainfall. These elements can lift, crack, or dislodge ridge cap shingles, leading to exposure of the underlying structure. Age-related wear and tear, UV degradation, and improper installation are also contributing factors. We focus on durable solutions designed to withstand the region's specific weather challenges.
acceptedAnswer.description: Severe weather (hail, wind, rain), age, UV degradation, and improper installation are common causes of ridge damage in DFW.
